summary: Defines extensions to OSPF and IS-IS to advertise the Traffic Engineering capabilities of routers, for example whether a router can act as a branch point for a point-to-multipoint LSP. Path selection for MPLS and GMPLS can then take those capabilities into account. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Routers shout out what special jobs they can do, so the planner picks routes only through ones that can actually do the job.

questions: how to advertise te node capabilities in ospf
